solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: King leaving boat in East thanks military leaders

indicators.note: the King is leaving the boat, so his letter is dropped from it

parts.note: a junk is a flat-bottomed sailing boat of China and the Far East
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king
ta is informal British for thanks

explanation.surface: A monarch quits his oriental vessel while thanking the army chiefs.
explanation.definitionFit: A junta is a group of officers ruling a country after seizing power.

clue.text: Article supporting politician in gaol leads UN to act prematurely

indicators.note: the gaol piece leads, coming before the letters UN
the politician and article are placed inside the gaol

parts.note: jug is slang for prison

indicators.note: in a down clue, the article sits beneath the politician and so props it up

parts.note: MP, Member of Parliament
the is the definite article
UN, the United Nations, taken as written

explanation.surface: An MP backed by some article ends up in prison ahead of the United Nations.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'supporting' means sitting below, so the article comes after the politician; 'leads' just means the gaol part comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: To jump the gun is an idiom from racing: starting before the starter's pistol, so acting too early.

clue.text: Head teachers getting together

definitions.meaning: the ..., National Union of Teachers, is a British teachers' union, a body where teachers join together

explanation.surface: A head teacher gathers the staff.
explanation.definitionFit: Nut is slang for the head, and the NUT was the National Union of Teachers in Britain.

clue.text: Boys out of bounds in middle of narrow ravine

indicators.note: the shortened boys go inside the centre of the other word
only the letters between the ends of narrow are used
bounds are the edges, so the first and last letters of Boys are removed

explanation.surface: Lads who have strayed past the limits are found deep in a narrow gully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of bounds' trims Boys at both edges, not a reference to trespassing.
explanation.definitionFit: An arroyo is a steep-sided gully cut by water in arid regions of the American Southwest.

clue.text: Limit placed on common use of straw hat in service

indicators.note: in an across clue, the limit is placed after the other piece

parts.note: straw is commonly used as forage, food for livestock
a cap is an upper limit

explanation.surface: A limit is imposed on using straw for a hat worn in the forces.
explanation.definitionFit: A forage cap is a soldier's peaked or side cap worn with everyday uniform.

clue.text: Horrendous fine legal

parts.note: F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine
rightful means lawful, legal

explanation.surface: Someone complains that a perfectly legal penalty is outrageous.
explanation.definitionFit: Frightful and horrendous are synonyms meaning very bad or shocking.

clue.text: Yankee in retreat used up foreign currency

indicators.note: the Yankee letter is put inside the other piece
in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a lair is a hiding place or retreat
Y is Yankee in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An American in a secluded spot has spent all his foreign money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns LAIR into RIAL; 'in' puts Y inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The riyal is the currency unit of Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Oman.

clue.text: For one mounted, running battle's a possibility

indicators.note: in a down clue, mounted means the abbreviation is raised, read upwards

parts.note: eg (exempli gratia) means for example, for one

indicators.note: running suggests the letters of battle are in motion and rearranged

explanation.surface: For a cavalryman, an ongoing fight may be winnable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mounted' turns EG into GE; 'running' rearranges BATTLE into TTABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something gettable is obtainable, so it counts as a realistic prospect.

clue.text: Face matter better with husband absent

parts.note: to count is to matter

indicators.note: the husband is absent, so his letter goes from the word for better

parts.note: to enhance is to better or improve

explanation.surface: Advice to deal with problems more effectively once the husband has left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Face' looks like a verb to go with 'matter'; it is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Countenance is a literary word for the face or its expression.

clue.text: Gentle reminder acceptable during exercise

indicators.note: the acceptable word comes during, inside, the exercise abbreviation

parts.note: PE, physical education
OK means acceptable

explanation.surface: A soft nudge that something is permissible during a workout.
explanation.definitionFit: A poke is a prod, figuratively a nudge to remind someone.

clue.text: Graduate takes ages, heading off for period around arrival time

parts.note: MA, Master of Arts

indicators.note: the heading, the first letter, comes off the word for ages

parts.note: an eternity is informally ages, a very long time

explanation.surface: A student who has graduated takes forever before setting out.
explanation.definitionFit: Maternity covers pregnancy and the time around a baby's birth, its arrival.

clue.text: Business van

definitions.meaning: ... means dealings, business, as in having no ... with
a goods vehicle such as a van

explanation.surface: A firm's delivery vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: Truck means trade or dealings, and also a goods vehicle.

clue.text: Conservatively speaking they lost at sea, beaten

indicators.note: beaten, like an egg, means the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Understated news that a defeated crew was lost at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: To say the least is a phrase signalling understatement, a deliberately cautious estimate.

clue.text: These miners supply bits and pieces

indicators.note: read as supple-ly, in a pliant way, so the letters are bent into a new order

explanation.surface: Mine workers provide fragments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supply' looks like a verb but is the adverb from supple, flexibly.
explanation.definitionFit: Smithereens are small fragments, as in blown to smithereens.

clue.text: Sides of bridge between teeth forming bonds

indicators.note: the outer letters go between letters of the teeth word

parts.note: dentures are false teeth

indicators.note: the sides of bridge are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A dentist builds a bridge between teeth so they bond.
explanation.walkthrough: The dental surface is a decoy: bridge only supplies its two end letters, and bonds are financial.
explanation.definitionFit: Debentures are long-term loans issued by companies, a kind of bond.

clue.text: Bad, as it happens to point the wrong way

indicators.note: facing the wrong way means the word is read backwards

parts.note: a live broadcast goes out as it happens

explanation.surface: It is wicked, someone says, that the signpost faces the wrong direction.
explanation.definitionFit: Evil means morally bad, wicked.

clue.text: Leaving money in account not collected?

parts.note: off means leaving, as in I'm off
the balance is the money held in an account

explanation.surface: Questioning whether money left in an account was ever drawn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'collected' suggests picking up money; it means composed, calm.
explanation.definitionFit: Off balance means flustered, not composed or collected.

clue.text: Faulty line inscribed in medal I cast

indicators.note: the line is written into the medal abbreviation

parts.note: BEM, British Empire Medal
to cast skin or a coat is to shed it

explanation.surface: A defective line was engraved on the medal I made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' looks like an anagram signal for 'medal I'; it is SHED.
explanation.definitionFit: Blemished means marked or flawed, so imperfect.

clue.text: Queen under pressure to contact evangelist

indicators.note: in a down clue, the Queen goes beneath the other pieces

parts.note: P is the physics abbreviation for pressure
to reach someone is to contact them
ER, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: The monarch is urged to get in touch with a missionary.
explanation.definitionFit: An evangelist preaches the gospel, so is a preacher.

clue.text: Fifty in a hundred sacked, English included, without warning

indicators.note: the fifty letter goes inside the rearranged letters
sacked, like a looted city, means the letters are thrown into disorder

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Half of a hundred workers fired, the English among them, with no notice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sacked' rearranges A HUNDRED with E (English being 'included' in the pool) into UNHERADED; 'in' puts L inside after the A.
explanation.definitionFit: Unheralded means not announced beforehand, so arriving unexpectedly.

clue.text: Never again paid for by church

parts.note: on as in it's on me, paid for by someone
CE, Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone vows not to repeat a charitable donation to the church.
explanation.definitionFit: Done once means done only one time, and never repeated.

clue.text: Dictator's address cut short in error

indicators.note: the shortened word goes inside the word for error

parts.note: a sin is a wrong, an error

indicators.note: cut short means the last letter is lopped off

parts.note: a talk is an address or speech

explanation.surface: A tyrant's speech is truncated by mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dictator's address' reads as one phrase, but the 's is a link and address is a speech of its own.
explanation.definitionFit: Joseph Stalin ruled the Soviet Union as an absolute dictator.

clue.text: Extremely remote date for renewal of contract?

indicators.note: only the extremes, the end letters, of remote are used

parts.note: a date is an appointment

explanation.surface: A very distant date being set for a contract to be renewed.
explanation.definitionFit: Being reappointed is being given one's post again, with the question mark allowing contract as the example.

clue.text: Choice bishop makes directly

parts.note: plum means choice, as in a plum job
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A selected bishop acts decisively.
explanation.definitionFit: Plumb means exactly or directly, as in plumb in the middle.

clue.text: Where you'd hope to recover charge

definitions.meaning: a hospital ... is where patients recuperate
a person in someone's charge, such as a child under a guardian

explanation.surface: A hospital bed you'd hope to get better in costs money.
explanation.definitionFit: Ward is a room of hospital beds and also a dependant under protection.

clue.text: A Hebraic drink with degree of acidity

parts.note: ale is beer, a drink
pH is the chemical measure of acidity

explanation.surface: A Hebrew drink with a certain sourness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A' belongs to the definition, the Hebrew equivalent of A, not a letter in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Aleph is the first letter of the Hebrew alphabet, its counterpart of A.

clue.text: Buoyant composer reflected on complete suite, perhaps

parts.note: up means cheerful, buoyant
Gustav Holst, English composer of The Planets

indicators.note: reflected, as in a mirror, means the word is read backwards

parts.note: re means about, on

explanation.surface: A cheerful composer muses on finishing a musical suite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suite' suggests music; it is a set of furniture, which you might upholster.
explanation.definitionFit: To upholster is to pad and cover chairs and sofas, finishing a three-piece suite.

clue.text: One identifying secret agent's features

indicators.note: the answer features in, is contained in, the words secret agent

explanation.surface: Something that pins down a spy's distinguishing marks.
explanation.definitionFit: A tag is a label that identifies something or someone.

clue.text: Specified son with copy from author caught in act

indicators.note: the son and copy are trapped inside the act

parts.note: a deed is an act
to crib is to copy another writer's work

explanation.surface: A son plagiarising a writer is caught in the act.
explanation.definitionFit: Described means set out or specified in words.

clue.text: Leading old African general returning from America

indicators.note: returning means the abbreviation for general is read backwards

parts.note: US, United States

explanation.surface: A senior African commander comes back from the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Negus was the title of the Ethiopian emperor, a historic African ruler.
